putInAccess.sourceName: Wyoming Game and Fish Department — River Access Points (All_River_Access_Points/FeatureServer/0)
putInAccess.note: Boating access is documented by WGFD River Access Points OBJECTID 121 ('Twin Creek', listed as a launch and take-out). The coordinate is WGFD Public Access Area facilities (PAA_Facilities/FeatureServer/3), OBJECTID 24116 'South Fork Shoshone River-Twin Creek Trailhead: Twin Creek parking area' (Parking), 9 m from the WGFD point; approximate area, not the exact launch. Why not exact: no agency boat-facility point within 100 m; coordinate is a nearby agency access/parking feature.
putInAccess.directions: Approximate area only: the Twin Creek access listed by Wyoming Game and Fish, at or near the agency feature 'South Fork Shoshone River-Twin Creek Trailhead: Twin Creek parking area'. Locate the launch on site; stay on public ground — the streambed and banks next to private land are private.
